entries.title: Upcoming Next.js November Security Release
entries.summary: Next.js is preparing a scheduled November security release for November 3, 2026.
entries.content:
Next.js is preparing a scheduled security release for Tuesday, November 3, 2026. This advance notice gives teams time to plan upgrades before patches are published.

The November 3 release will address seven medium vulnerabilities in Next.js. We will publish the full advisories alongside the release, including impact, affected versions, and upgrade instructions. We recommend upgrading to a patched version once the release is available.

We work with security researchers to secure Next.js and other open source frameworks through Vercel's Open Source Bug Bounty. Anyone interested in contributing to the security of eligible frameworks is encouraged to participate there.

Any questions or concerns regarding our security programs or vulnerability management can be sent to security@vercel.com.
